model.cause: The shared stroke parser proved a finite nonnegative resolved width; the even-width fast gate proved integrality. A second integer syntax parse rejected physical suffixes. Separately, percentage offsets reused a number/px parser after stripping%, accepting px% as a number.
model.change: Convert the admitted width to the existing integer domain. Parse percentage offsets directly as finite doubles without a temporary substring; ordinary number/px offsets retain their helper. Integer path validation moves byte-exactly into its sole caller. No new cache, owner, raster numerical route or API.
model.coverage: Twelve width spellings cover all fixed units and signed/physical zero; four declaration paths cover attribute, inline, inherited and stylesheet widths. Two outline routes and four source errors remain. Four invalid percentage spellings and seven exact finite/domain controls protect the offset change. One native fixture adds caps/dashes/zero through canonical conversion; the general API matrix is unchanged.

documentation: Support guidance distinguishes stroke fixed lengths, filter-region number/px/percentage values and unitless offsets/deviations, plus text position, text/path length and font-size domains. This corrects omissions without widening unrelated admissions.
unchanged: All existing tests, fixtures, native references, tolerances, licenses and text-layout implementation remain. New references were frozen before the fix; hosted SVG payloads are not retained.
